tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rwa lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog dang bcas pa gdug pa gzhom pa'i me phung bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rwa lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog dang bcas pa gdug pa gzhom pa'i me phung bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rwa lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog dang bcas pa gdug pa gzhom pa'i me phung bzhugs so//

༄༅// 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' gdug pa'i ngor// dus kyi dag pa'i gzugs mchog rab drag pa// rdo rje 'jigs byed la btud de sgrub pa// la li ta yi ring lugs 'dir gsal bya// las dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i blos/ yo byad kun 'dzoms pas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste 'chad par 'gyur pa bzhin 'byung po la gtor ma byin nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba dang nyi ma la hūm̐ yig rab tu 'bar ba/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer 'phreng bas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ hrīḥha bho mahā kro dha ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha asmat+ta pū dza pra ti gṛh+ṇan+tu pra sā dha me dhī man+ku ru swā hā/ spyan drangs/ 'khor dang bcas pa la snying ga nas 'phros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ-i ha/ mchod yon/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhabs bsil / oṃ bi kra tā na na duṣ+ṭa satwa da ma ka gaḥgaḥgaḥ dri chab/ oṃ ku mā ra rū pī ni dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ na/ me tog oṃ hrīḥha he phaṭ/ bdug spos/ oṃ dīp+ta lo tsa ni bi kṛ tā na na mahā aṭ+ṭa ṭ+ṭa ha sa na di ni dīp+ta ya swā hā/ mar me/ oṃ badz+ra ne wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhal zas kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig de bzhin/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig snyam pa'i tshangs pa'i gnas pas gnas nas/ gtso bo nam mkhar/ gzhan lha dang chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shun+yā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

de las sngon gyi smon lam dran te sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir oṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can rdo rje rgya gram du chags pa'i dbus su bdag nyid āḥlas zla ba la dhīḥmatshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dmar ser phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan te sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma/ de las 'od zer gyi rtser 'jam dpal gyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa 'phros nas bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad bsgral/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang lha dang khro bo'i tshogs thams cad bsdus te 'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi mar ro gcig tu gyur pas/ thams cad kyi bdag nyid nyin mor byed pa de gdug pa chen po'i 'od zer 'bar ba dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa/ de'i dbus su rin po che dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa pad+ma'i 'phreng ba dang dur khrod dang rdo rje dang me'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'i lha snam gnyis kyi nang ma'i grur bum pa gnyis kyi dbus su/ ka pā la khrag gis gang bas spras pa'i dbus thod pa skam rlon gyi rtsig pa can gyi gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo bzhi pa/ gzhan gsum bcad cing mdun sgo phye ba'i lte bar re mig dgu pa zlum po shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ba'i lha'i gnas thams cad du pad+ma zla ba'i gdan gyi khar/ dbus su phyogs skyong pho mo'i steng du ro/ shar du mgo lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang*/ mer thod pa/ srin po thod tshal/ rlung du dur khrod kyi ras/ dbang ldan du gsal shing gis phug pa'i skyes bu/ shar gyi snam bur gri gug rdo rje rtse gcig gtun shing*/ chu gri/ mtshon rtse gcig lcags kyu/

ma he/ ba glang ste brgyad/ lhor sta re/ mda'/ dbyug tho/ kha ṭ+waṃ/ 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ phag pa/ bong bu ste brgyad/ nub tu rdo rje/ rnge'u chung*/ phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ rnga mo/ khyi ste brgyad/ byang du sdigs mdzub/ 'phan lce gsum pa/ glang lpags/ tho ba/ mdung*/ me thab/ lug spyang gi ste brgyad/ shar sgor bya rgod/ lho sgor 'ug pa/ nub tu bya rog byang du ni tse/ mer bya khyung*/ bden bral du khra/ rlung du ri skegs/ dbang ldan du bzhad/ de thams cad zla ba'i gzugs su gyur ba'i dbus mar dhīḥgazhan rnams la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ saṃ raṃ dhaṃ kaṃ /baṃ khaṃ maiṃ maṃ dz+nyāṃ waṃ tsaṃ dz+nyāṃ/ biṃ yaṃ muṃ dhaṃ/ raṃ taṃ haṃ dzāṃ/ bhaṃ baṃ rāṃ raṃ/ sāṃ raṃ sūṃ bāṃ/ keṃ haṃ gaṃ dz+nyāṃ saṃ saṃ aṃ aṃ/ aṃ sāṃ s+phaṃ ghaṃ/ sūṃ uṃ hūm̐ aṃ/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las dbus su 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ phyogs bzhir gti mug dang rdzun dang chags pa dang phrag dog gi 'jam dpal/ mtshams su sems ma rdo rje ma/ rin chen rdo rje ma/ chos kyi rdo rje ma/ las kyi rdo rje ma/ lha khyams shar du/ rdo rje sna tshogs/ rdo rje ral gri/ byams pa/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes sku/ ngag gi dbang phyug zla ba'i 'od/ ye shes mtsho brgyad/ lho ru rdo rje sna tshogs/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje bsrungs ba/ rdo rje rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyu/ rdo rje dra ba'i 'od brgyad/ nub tu rdo rje smra ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje legs pa/ rdo rje rin chen/ nyi 'od/ rdo rje nyi ma brgyad/ byang du rdo rje dpal/ rdo rje bzhad/ spos kyi glang po/ rdo rje tog dpa' bar 'gro ba/ rgya mtsho'i glog blo gros mi zad pa/ bdud rtsi'i 'od brgyad/ sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu/ grwar rdo rje gnod mdzes/

rdo rje gtsug tor/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ gtso bo mthing gzhan thams cad phyogs mdog 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gzugs can/ de dag gi thugs kar a las nyi ma/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul nas mnyes par byas/ slar 'dus de nyid la thim pas 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin bsgom mo// de nas 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gtso bo la bskor nas lhan cig tu de la thim de nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭā+-iḥwi/ mtshams bzhir kṛ tā na na/ khyams gyi shar du/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya/ lhor/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ nub tu/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ byang du/ ya da yo ni yak+ṣe ya/ sgor ya māṃ ta ka grwar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ rang phyogs kyi mdog mtshams 'od zer lnga pa de dag las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas rig 'dzin dang lha khro bo'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs de dag gi thad kyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa/ yi ge de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su khro bo rdo rje chen po kha dog nag po gzhan rnams rdo rje phra mo'i gzugs su gyur pa'i steng gi sangs rgyas la sogs pas sems can smin pa dang byang chub la bkod par mdzad nas slar 'ongs pa de dag la thim/ yang de so so'i steng gi thad kyi nam mkhar ro la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rnams 'od zer 'bar ba nyi ma la gnas pas ma rungs pa thams cad bsgral te de dag rang gi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭā+-iḥwi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing nag gsus khyim che zhing yan lag rags pa/ zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa sku las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ khams gsum po thams cad za bar nus pa/ mi'i khrag zhag sha tshil rkang rnams gsol ba/

zhal nas 'jigs pa chen po'i pheṃ sgra gnam du 'don zhing*/ rkang pa'i stabs kyis sa gzhi gnon pa/ mi mgo'i ga shal dang*/ thod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sbrul mchod phyir thogs pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po ma he cung zad khro ba/ g.yas mthing dmar ser brtsegs pa dang*/ g.yon dkar po dud kha nag po brtsegs pa rnams shin tu khro ba/ steng rwa'i dbus su 'jigs byed zhal dmar po khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal ser po cung zad khro ba/ zur phud can/ re re'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ smin ma dang skra bsgreng ba/ 'jigs pa chen po'i dus lta bur zhud pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas kyi dang po gri gug gnyis pa rdo rje rtse gcig gsum pa gtun shing*/ bzhi pa chu gri/ lnga pa rtse gcig pa'i mdung thung*/ drug pa dgra sta/ bdun pa mdung*/ brgyad pa mda'/ dgu pa lcags kyu/ bcu pa dbyug tho/ bcu gcig pa kha ṭ+wāṃ/ bcu gnyis pa 'khor lo/ bcu gsum pa rdo rje/ bcu bzhi pa tho ba/ bco lnga pa ral gri/ bcu drug pa rnge'u chung*/ lhag ma'i g.yon gyi dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa mgo gsum pa phub/ bzhi pa rkang*/ lnga pa zhags pa/ drug pa gzhu/ bdun pa rgyu ma/ brgyad pa dril bu/ dgu pa lag pa/ bcu pa dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu gcig pa skyes bu gsal shing btsugs pa/ bcu gnyis pa me thab/ bcu gsum pa thod tshal/ bcu bzhi pa sdigs mdzub/ bco lnga pa 'phan/ bcu drug pa rlung gi ras/ g.yas kyi zhabs dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma he/ gsum pas ba glang*/ bzhi pas bong bu/ lnga pas rnga mo/ drug pas khyi/ bdun pas lug brgyad pas spyang ki g.yon kyi zhabs dang pos bya rgod/ gnyis pas 'ug pa/ gsum pas bya rog bzhi pas ne tso/ lnga pas khyung*/ drug pas khra/ bdun pas ri skegs/ brgyad pas bzhad rnams brdzis pa/ re mig gi phyogs bzhir/

rdo rje mgo rdo rje lag rdo rje rgyu ma/ rdo rje rkang*/ mtshams bzhir/ rdo rje thod pa/ rdo rje thod tshal/ rdo rje dur khrod kyi ras/ gsal shing gis phug pa'i skyes bu/ phyi'i snam bur rdo rje gri gug rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje gtun shing*/ rdo rje chu gri/ rdo rje mtshon rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje ma he/ rdo rje ba lang dang*/ rdo rje sta re/ rdo rje mda'/ rdo rje dbyug tho/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wā/ཾ rdo rje 'khor lo/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje phag pa/ rdo rje bong bu rnams dang*/ rdo rje/ rdo rje rnge'u chung*/ rdo rje phub/ rdo rje gzhu/ rdo rje dril bu/ rdo rje rlung ras/ rdo rje rnga mo/ rdo rje khyi rnams dang*/ rdo rje sdigs mdzub/ rdo rje 'phan lce gsum pa/ rdo rje glang lpags/ rdo rje tho ba/ rdo rje mdung*/ rdo rje me thab/ rdo rje lug rdo rje spyang ki shar sgor rdo rje bya rgod/ lho sgor rdo rje 'ug pa/ nub sgor rdo rje bya rog byang sgor rdo rje seng ge mer rdo rje bya khyung*/ srin por rdo rje khra/ rlung du rdo rje ri skegs/ dbang ldan du rdo rje bzhad/ thams cad kha dog nag po phyag gnyis g.yas thams cad rdo rje/ g.yon mgo sogs rang ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ drag shul chen por khros pa'i ma he'i zhal gdangs shing pheṃ sgrog pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra brdzes pa la thod pas brgyan te bcom ldan 'das la blta ba/ mtshams ma bzhi ma gtogs gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi snying gar rang rang gi sa bon/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ phyogs la so so'i de bzhin gshegs pas rgyas btab bo// de nas bsdus pa sngar gyi sngags kyis sam/ rgyas par spro na/ hūm̐/ dgra bo mthar byed 'tshubs mas dkrugs pa'i khrag /mi bzad bsgul ba rlung 'khor ral pa'i byings// bsad pa'i ro tshogs lang long rgyu ba can// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ chen por kun nas sbreng*// nag po ha la ha la zhu ba'i chu// dug rlangs 'khrugs pas dgra bo rmongs rengs dang*// smyo 'bog brgyal dang 'chi bar byed pa'i rbas// ma lus brdzis pa'i zhabs zung rnam par bkru// mi ro las bton rgyu ma'i thag pa la// g.yul ngor sna tshogs mtshon bsnun bsad gtubs pa'i// mgo lag dbang po don lnga snod rgyus pa// dur khrod chen po'i me tog 'phreng bar sbrel// dad pa dregs pa rngams nas 'khol 'gyur ba// rab 'jigs du ba 'tshubs pa'i mun pa'i mthings// me stag skar mda' ltung dang rgyug byed pa'i// gdug pa'i dri can thams cad spos su sbyar// nyin mor byed pa bsad pa'i dmar ba'i khrag /phyogs kyi dgong la 'thug por byug 'dod pa'i// ro ras sbrang chen gyis sbangs sbar ba'i ngar// ma lus mun la mthar byed gtum por btang*// glang chen zla bor zhe sdang mes bzhu zhing*// myos byed kyis rbad 'gram pa nas zags pa'i// 'gi'u waṃ dri bzang bung ba'i gter 'dzin pa// sim pa bskyed pa'i byug pa mchog tu byas// phyogs rnams dpung bzhi'i sprin gyis bkab nas su// mtshon cha'i glog g.yo mda' rnon lce 'bab pas// bdud bzhi kha btags bla tshe srog dbugs sogs// g.yul ngor rgyal ba'i dga' ston chen por bsgrigs// sdig spyod rnams la chad las bzod dka' bar// lhung bas g.yon can rang dang de yi phyogs// dpa' 'khums ci bya gtol med ngu ba'i sgra// chos kyi dar chen 'phyar ba'i rol mor 'bul// mdun du yaṃ las rlung*/

de'i steng du raṃ las me/ de'i steng du mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi khar a las thod pa'i snod/ nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ go rim bzhin gnas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje thams cad spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig yi ge gsum yang de la thim pa sbyangs sbel sbar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje bu gu can du gyur pas gsol/ mnyes par bsam mo/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ma bcos mkhyen pa'i thugs// 'jam dpal rgyu yi byang sems sku// ut+pal ral gri rab bsnams shing*// zur phud lnga ldan gur kum mdog /zla gdan la bzhugs ye shes kyi// sku mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdud 'joms la// sangs rgyas sras bcas 'dren pa yi// 'jam dbyangs thugs khros hūm̐ nag po// dngos grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje khros pas srid gsum sbyong*// spro zhing bsdus pas ma he'i zhal// ljags dril pheṃ gyi 'brug sgra sgrog /hriḥṣ+ṭā+-i gsung 'jigs la phyag 'tshal// dbu dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi phyag /bcu drug zhabs can dpa' bo che// mig sman brdar lta'i sku mchog ni// 'jigs dus me 'dra'i gshin rje gshed// gnag dang dmar dang ser zhal dbus// dkar dang dung mdog gnag zhal g.yon// sngo dang dmar dang ser zhal g.yas// zhal dgus srid gsum gsol ba po// gri gug rtse gcig gtun shing dang*// chu gri 'phang mdung dgra sta mdung*// mda' dang lcags kyu dbyug tho dang*// kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo rdo rje dang*// tho ba ral gri ḍā ma ru// g.yas pa'i phyag na bsnams pa'o// thod pa mgo bo phub dang rkang*// zhags pa gzhu dang rgyu ma dang*// dril bu lag pa dur ras dang*// gsal shing phug dang mer bcas thab// ro snod sdigs mdzub ba dan dang*// rlung ras phyag na bsnams pa po// gnyis ni glang chen ko rlon gon// mi dang ma he glang dang ni// bong bu rnga mo khyi dang lug

/ce spyang g.yas kyi zhabs brgyad gnon// bya rgod 'ug pa bya rog dang*// ne tso khyung dang ri skegs dang*// sngags can bzhad bya brgyad po la// g.yon zhabs 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam nyid mi g.yo dur khrod rje// ltung ba'i lha gnyis sdig pa'i sku// sdigs mdzub drag pos gdul dka' 'dul// go bzlog mnan nas rab tu gsol// lid+ga langs shing rtog pa spangs/ dpa' bo mnan nas gnyis med rol// lha min kun sogs dbang pos btud// mun sel thugs kyi mngon gyur pa// rnam rtog gshin rje 'dra ba rnams// nyid rol pa yi rnam rtog gis// gar mkhan ral gri 'bar ba yin// gnyug ma'i gnas la 'god pa'o// 'jam dpal ye shes snying rje khro// e ma srid gsum dgug pa sel// bu la ma byams gshe ba ltar// bcos ma'i khro byad khyod phyag 'tshal//

zhes pas bstod/ de nas gtso bo'i snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ mthing nag mtha' mar sngags 'phreng rab tu 'bar ba la'am/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i spro bsdu la dmigs nas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭā+-iḥbi kri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ nye snying*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so// de las skyo na rnam dag bsgom par bya ste/ dam pa'i don du rnam dag pa// dus ni dpa' bo chen po'i gzugs// zhal brgyad thun tshod brgyad yin no// dgu pa thun tshod spyi yin no// phyag dang zhabs gnyis zla ba dang*// zla ba phyed dang yang dag sbyor// bzhon pa bcu drug dus dang ni// zla ba yi ni zhag tu shes// zhal ni gza' dgu dag tu shes// phyag ni rgyu skar dag dang sbyor// zhabs ni 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang*// dus bzhi yang ni de bzhin no// mtshon cha rnams ni stong pa dang*// snying rje dag ni bcu drug gnyis// glang chen lpags pa bgegs chen te// drag po'i gzugs ni sdug bsngal ba// sel bar byed pa'i gtso bo'o// kha dog nag po byams pa che// thod pa'i rgyan ni mi 'gyur ba'o// dkyil 'khor lha ni thams cad dag /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dus dag go /sngags gsum dag pa sku gsum mo// lha rnams nyid kyi rang ming ni// dang por oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭ mtha'// thod par btung ba'i dus dag go /dkyil 'khor byang chub phyogs yin no// bzhon pa sa ri san+ti ka /mdog sogs de bzhin gshegs pa ste// dag pa thams cad shes pa'o// zhes brjod cing bstan par bya'o// de nas bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa dang*/ sha khrag rus pa la sogs dang*/ bza' btung 'bras bu thams cad thod pa'am ru sbal gyi khog par bcas la/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dag par rab 'byams kyi mdangs/ nam mkha'i snod chen por phyi nang gsang bar 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi khar/

bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs dang dgra bo thams cad bsgral ba'i sha'i khor yug chen pos bskor ba/ khrag zhag klad pa'i rgyu mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa/ rus pa sna tshogs pa'i ri bo/ lha ba dang dwangs ma'i rol pa'i chu gter chen pos dkris pa/ snying dang glo ba dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ mtsher pa dang*/ mkhal ma dang*/ rgyu ma dang*/ nang khrol gzhan dang*/ mgo lag dang*/ mig la sogs pa dbang po thams cad spungs pa'i lhun po/ mthong na bred pa'i gzugs thams cad par 'char ba/ mi sdug pa'i sgra thams cad kyis khol ba/ bam zhing myags pa/ rul zhing sums pa la sogs pa'i dri nga ba thams cad 'tshubs pa/ phyogs bcu'i bam pho mo thams cad sing nga ro len ma rnams kyis der 'dor ba/ pags pa khrag gis sbags pa thams cad g.yab mo dang bcas te reg byar 'thibs pa/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gsum gyi bza' ba dang btung ba dang bca' ba dang myang ba dang bldag pa dang gzhib pa'i zas kyi gnas thams cad snang ba/ yongs 'du dang 'dzam bu dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pa'i 'bras bu/ ma rmos pa la sogs pa'i 'bru/ bi dza pū ra la sogs pa'i sman/ 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i bcud thams cad chags pa/ dbang du byed pa'i la du/ nyams pa'i srog dbugs bla tshe khar rje dbang thang rlung rta la sogs pa'i khyim gyi 'khor lo sgang gshong du 'khor ba/ rmang srid pa'i gting du bcas pa/ mtho dgung sngon gyi dbyings su sleb pa/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' tshun chad du brdal ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams hab hab rgyug cing*/ dungs dungs por 'khrungs nas rngam rngam por rkan sgra gtog bzhin pas dur khrod kyi ro la bya rgod kyis rub pa lta bur thugs kyi re ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du gsol bar 'gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs rnams mu ran la 'khod pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

nas mchod pa'i bar tshogs zhing bzhin byas/ de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas lha rnams kyi ljags byin gyis brlabs nas nye snying gi mthar/ badz+ra bhai ra ba a dhi pa ti/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ de nas 'byung po rnams la/ oṃ bhū tsa ra naṃ/ ya pa tā la tsā rā naṃ/ ma na khe rā tsā naṃ/ ta bur+b+bā dhi ga naṃ/ ka dak+ṣi ṇā dhi ga ta naṃ/ hūm̐ pañci mā dhi ga tā naṃ/ phaṭ ut+ta ra a dhi ga tā naṃ/ oṃ ī hrīḥyaṣ+ṭā+-i ba/ wi k+ṣo kṛ ko ta e na ya na de hūm̐ bh+yaḥphaṭ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥ zhes pas sbyin/ las kyi bye brag gi 'phrin las bcol/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub blang*/ khyad par du bla ma smod par byed pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang*/ bstan la gnod par byed pa dang*/ sems can kun la gnod byed dang*/ sngags rgyud la gnod byed pa'i mi/ 'di rnams khyed kyis gsad du gsol/ zhes so// gnang ba byin pas bsam/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ bdag bskyed kyi lha thams cad rang la bstim/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i nga rgyal gyis smon lam btab/ rjes kyi spyod lam la ci bde bar 'jug go /bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga bya bar 'dod pas/ sngon la bsnyen pa byas nas las dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ sa bslang ba'i phyir bde ba'i stan la 'dug pas bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ mdun du me tog gi tshom bu mtha' mchod pas bskor ba byas nas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes brjod nas thal mo rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya sa la brdabs pas sa'i lha mo gser btso ma'i mdog can sku phyed tsam sa nas 'thon pa la/

oṃ pri thi wī de wī ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wid+yā/ shap+ta rnams kyis mchod/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul/ sems can rnams kyi don du dkyil 'khor byed pas bdag la sa byin cig ces brjod pas/ khyod dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po yin pas dkyil 'khor gyis shig ces gnang ba byin nas/ slar yang sa la thim/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya bzlas shing gang la dmigs pa'i sa de tshon skud dang phur bus bskor/ sa brko ba la sogs pa dgos na sa'i lha mo nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol te lto 'phye brtags nas brko/ ro lnga bsal gter dang rjes mthun gyi sas dbus cung zad mtho ba'i stegs bu dang bcas pa bya/ de nas dri'i byug pas dkyil 'khor nyis 'dab tsam byas pa'i dbus su rdo rje slob dpon chas su zhugs pa dang phyogs bzhir slob ma bkod mchod pa bshams bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ sa gzhi stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsams la/ sems can kun kyi sems chen po// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas bdag bskyed bsdus nas/ slob dpon rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa mig ma dang a las nyi zla 'od zer dang ldan pas 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ rkang pa'i 'og tu hūm̐ las rdo rje rgya gram 'od 'bar ba bsams te rdo rje'i blta ba dang rdo rje'i 'gros kyis byang shar nas brtsams te skor ba gsum/ hūm̐ ha'i zlos pas bgegs bskrad/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug pas/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i bgegs mthar byed stod phur bu smad rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje phur bu'i rnam par snang bas bgegs rnams kyi mgo bor gnas pa/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na phaṭ phaṭ/ kī lā ya kī lā ya/ sarba pā pāṃ phaṭ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī lā ya/

badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ badz+ra bigh+na nāṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+taṃ kī lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ sngags kyis gdab pas spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug ste g.yo 'gul med par gyur/ dngos su las kyi rdo rjes phur skor byed cing phyogs bcur gdab bo// sa yongs su bzung ba'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sar sa bslang pa bzhin gyis sa lha lhag gnas bya/ lha gnas ma 'chol bar tshom bu bkod mchod pas bskor/ stong pa nyid nas bstod pa'i bar byas/ mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ bdug spos 'thul rol mo dang pus btsugs kyis/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal rdo rje ni// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag ni gshin rje gshed dkyil 'khor// mgon po bdag gis bri bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bcom ldan bdag ni gus dag la// byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol// sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs// 'khor lo 'gro ba'i don mdzad de// 'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// gsang sngags kyi ni lha gzhan dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po yang dag rdzogs pa yin// sangs rgyas bstan la mngon dga' ba// gang su lha yi mig can kun// che ge zhes bya'i rdo rje yis// gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i// ji ltar nye bar spyod nus pa// 'gro rnams don du bri bar bya// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa kun// thugs rjes nye bar gzung nas ni// thams cad dkyil 'khor la gzhug phyir// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lan gsum lha lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// de nas gser dngul gyi bum pa kha dog dkar por bsgyur ba lha grangs sam bcu gnyis sam drug la sna tshogs pad+ma la gri gug sogs so so'i mtshan ma/ las thams cad pa la sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa nang rdzas lnga tshan lnga chus sum gnyis bkang ba mgul chings nyis rim mam shing bzang po'i yal gas brgyan pa de nas bsangs/

bum pa rnams stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la nyi zla/ de'i steng du sa bon las phyag mtshan/ de las lhar skad cig gis bskyed/ las thams cad par bgegs mthar byed ye shes pa gzhug pa nas bstod pa'i bar bya/ bzlas pa'i mthar mchod yon la yig brgya ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i chus reg pa'i tshe na bdud rtsi'i chu'i rang bzhin du zhu/ las thams cad pa bgegs bsrung ba'i phyir mi zhu bar sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs par bsam/ bum pa lhag gnas so// de nas slob ma rnams shar phyogs su khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje slob dpon gtso bor mos pa la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas kyang*/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra 'i nas/ de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// de ltar yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog /ded dpon bzang dang bcas pa blang*// gal te bag med gang gyur na// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skyed par byed// ces brjod cing gcig gi lag pa nas bzung nas/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// sogs kyis spro ba bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs thun mong dang*/ bdag cag dus 'di nas gzung nas/ ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yis tshangs spyod gnyis med par// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrungs// zhes pa khyad par dang*/ de nas slob ma'i 'byung ba'i 'od kyi gong bu las oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur pas g.yas g.yon gang nas rlung rgyu ba de nas bsdus te thugs ka nas brgyud gsang gnas nas 'thon mdun du rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i snying mgrin spyi bor hūm̐ āḥ oṃ zhes brjod cing dris thig le bya/ snying gar khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/

de dag la rim pa bzhin thim par bsam zhing oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gnas gsum du rdo rje bzhag go /mchod pa phul rang rigs kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad zlos su gzhug de nas so shing me tog gi 'phreng ba can bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis btab pa sbyin nas slob mas rang gi so'i rtsa ba la drud nas badz+ra hā sa ha zhes tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i man+ḍal gyi khar dor bas gang du lhung ba'i phyogs kyi zhi sogs kyi las gang 'grub pa'i mtshan ma bshad do// oṃ hrīḥbi shud sogs kyis khyor chu/ de nas bsrung skud la rigs kyi snying po bzlas pa mdud pa gsum pa dpung pa g.yon par btags te/ bud dha mai trī rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes pas bsrung*/ ku sha las thams cad pa'i sngags btab pa sngas dang stan du sbyin/ bya ba gzhan gyis blo ma yengs par snying po'i don dpal gshin rje gshed 'ba' zhig la sems par gyis shig ces bshad de rmi lam brtag pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi khang par nyal du bzhag go /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin du gnas par bsam/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o// nang par dkyil 'khor yang dag par mchod nas steng gi nam mkhar gshegs su gsol/ tshom bu bsdu/ sa byi dor byas/ rang skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i mdun du tshon sna lnga'i skud pa so sor bkal ba oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥlas byung ba'i phyag mtshan lha de yongs su gyur pa las rigs lngar grub pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa bcug mchod/ slar zhu ba skud par gnas pa de'i sna sgrub grogs la dzaḥ zhes pas gtad cing*/ oṃ a n+yo sogs kyis bsgril/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon nub tu 'dug nas/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yon du gzung la gtso bor bsgoms pa'i lto bar khu tshur bzhag la/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes pas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes gyen du btab pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa dag 'gro ba'i don gyi dus la bab par bskul/

rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor du dmigs/ tshangs thig rnams gdab/ de nas las kyi thig skud gzhan gyi lag len bzhin btab pa dang*/ ye shes kyi thig btab pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam zhing*/ thig skud mchod de/ ye shes pa sngags kyis gshegs/ tshon sna lnga yang oṃ sogs sa bon lnga las byung ba'i dri dang bdud rtsis bsangs/ snga ma bzhin gyis byin brlab byas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes bzlas/ chos kyi dbyings de dag pas na// sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed// rgyal ba 'jam dpal rdo rje nyid// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// zhes brjod cing byang shar nas re khā lnga byas par thod pa bkab ste rkang pas mnan nas tshon pra brtag cing mtshan phyed kyi dus nas 'jigs byed kyi sbyor bas bri zhing mtshan ma la yang sgrub thabs nas bshad pa bzhin gyis so// de nas bum pa gtso bo dbus/ gzhan brgyad phyogs mtshams/ las thams cad pa byang shar du bzhag ste/ khyod kyis bgegs thams cad srung bar gyis shig oṃ bigh+nān ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭ/ zla'o// de nas mchod rdzas zhabs kyis mnan pa'i srog chags rnams kyi sha'i zhal zas/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshil chen gyi mar me brgyad kyang de bzhin/ sgo dang grwa bzhir khrag gi ar+ghaṃ thod par blugs pa/ gsur chen gyi bdug pa/ dgra bo'i mgo la sogs pa'i me tog kyang phyogs mtshams/ gzhan yang bdud rtsi bcu dang gtor ma dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad de mchod pa'i khyad par ji snyed pa yang bkod do// spyan gzigs la sogs pa bkod par khyad par 'phags par bya/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis rdor dril bzung 'bar ba'i blta ba dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas/

sum+bha na ི'i sngags kyi bsrung bar byas nas/ bdag bskyed/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsang gtor byas nas stong pa nyid bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed bum pa dang bcas pa la lha tshogs bskyed/ nam mkha' la gnas pa de 'bar ba'i blta ba dang*/ yi ge dza sbyor bas shrī badz+ra bhai ra ba mahā maṇ+ḍal ā be sha ya a a a/ zhes pas gnyis su med par gyur pas skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du grub pa gtso 'khor thams cad kyi snying gar rang rang gi sa bon nas bstod pa'i bar bya'o// rgyas par 'dod na/ tshe bdag gi las byang bzhin gyis bsgral las kyi bstab pa'i bar 'don pa cung zad bsgyur bas kyang mchod do// mchod pa'i rim pa'o// de nas slob dpon gyis grub na zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg bya/ bdag 'jug byas te slob ma phyi rol du bkug kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas phyogs bzhi nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sdom pa thun mong rigs lnga spyi mthun dag pa'i dam tshig sngar bzhin phog bum pas khrus byas gdong bcing*/ de nas slob ma snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can dar zab kyis brgyan par bskyed/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog 'phreng ba len du gzhug rdo rje nas 'dzin du bcug zhal bzhi pa dang ta kṛ ta bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ khyod ni gang zhig ci la dga'// zhes dri/ skal ba bzang la bdag dga'o// zhes lan btab/ de nas sems bskyed pa yol ba'i nang du 'ong ba na/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta u pa ta yā mi/ zhes lan gsum brjod du bcug de'i snying gar rdo rje bdud rtsi dang bcas pas rgyas btab/ de ring khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa de kho na nyid kyi gnas chen po 'di ni phyin ci ma log par brtag par byas te gang dag khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste dad pa chung ba dag dang yongs su ma smin pa rnams la smra bar mi rigs so// gal te smras na mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur ro//

yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te rdo rje dang bcas pa'i bdud rtsi thig ler byas pa'i sgo nas so// de nyid nyi zla kha sbyor re re 'khod par bsam zhing*/ de nas phan yon nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa spyi mthun mtha' ma'i mthar oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ gnyis ka dang rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pa yang spyi bzhin byas nas/ bdag ni deng nas gzung nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs nas rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sbyar ba'i spos kyis bdug cing de nas slob ma 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can rin po che dang dar zab kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed bkug ste de la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya ā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes rdo rje rgya gram mgor bkod pas brtan par bya'o// de nas las kyi rdo rje dang bcas pas bstod pa tshigs su bcad pas kyang 'don cing dkyil 'khor la skor ba byas shar du tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor du dmigs te/ mahā pū dza su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod de me tog dor/ lha gang la babs pa de khyod kyi lha zhes brda sprad/ me tog de gang la phog pa de nyid kyi gtsug pud du bcings par bsam la/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa badz+ra hoḥmig gnyis su oṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad mthong bar bsgom ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// ye shes mchog tu gsal bar byed// he badz+ra pā sha/ gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu mahā maṇ+ḍal pra be sha ya phaṭ/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu'i dngos// dag cing gsal la ma rnyogs par// gang rtog zhing khams rnam dag mchog

/bla na med pa'i gnas mchog yin// rdo rje thugs rje'i rgyun gnas pas// sprul ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyun mi 'chad// bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis mthong*// phun sum tshogs kun 'dis 'grub 'gyur// dngos grub bsgrub phyir dam tshig skyong*// gsang sngags don la brtson par gyis// de nas dkyil 'khor rten brten par bcas pa bstan no// 'jug pa'o// de nas srod la slob ma gtso bor bskyed / byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ bum pa thams cad kyi chu gtso bum du bsdus nas de spyi bor dbang bskur zhing*/ rnal dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis 'byor pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu dbyangs kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa dus kyi tshe// lha rnams kun gyis dbang bskur ltar// de ltar de bzhin gshegs kun gyis// rigs kyi bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ye hūm̐/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes spyi bo nas blugs pas dri ma sbyangs/ cod pan las thams cad pas bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che pad+ma ral gri de dag yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung snang mtha' don grub rnams su gyur pas/ sangs rgyas kun dngos cod pan dbang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir// cod pan mchog gi dbang bskur bas// 'khor lo sgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur// oṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ hūm̐/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ mgo la bskyon/ hrīḥlas snang mtha'/ de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlab// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje mchog gi dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca mi/ rdo rje lag pa g.yas par gtad/ a las don grub gzhan 'dra/

chos kyi dril bu bla med don// stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrog pa'i// thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i// dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta pa ta le dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye hūm̐/ dril bu g.yon par gtad/ chos thams cad bde stong mnyam pa nyid du bsgrubs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ya hūm̐/ kye dpal/ che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// 'di ste sogs spyi mthun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stāṃ dhā ra ya mi hrīḥhi hi hi ho hūm̐ oṃ/ thog mthar med pa'i sems dpa' ni// zhes pa'i sh+lau kas rdo rje lag pa g.yas par gtad thugs kyi dam tshig 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sh+lau kas g.yon pas dril bu chos kyi dkrol/ gsung gi dam tshig bsnol ba'i phyag rgyas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag/ nas/ byed par 'gyur byas/ 'khor ba'i bde ba shin tu chung*// duḥkha chen po dag pa'i phyir// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di dag rtag tu skyongs// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ji ltar bde ba bsten bzhin du// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya'o// ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas mchog tu// thabs mkhas mchog chen bzhugs pa'i tshe// de srid sems can mtshungs med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// shes rab pha rol phyin mchog thabs// bsod nams byin rlabs kyis bsgrubs pa'i// dam tshig 'di dag rtag tu srungs// dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs// phyag rgya chen po'i brtul zhugs mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyis gnang ba sbyin// sku'i dam tshig sku phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i dbang dbu dgu nas// sku mchog ni/ bdud dpung 'joms phyir dbang bskur ro// gri gug rtse gcig nas/

ḍā ma rus/ bdud dpung 'joms phyir dbang bskur ro// g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan rnams dang*/ thod pa mgo bo nas/ ba dan ras/ bdud dpung 'joms phyir dbang bskur ro// g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gsum ga'i mthar yi ge bcu pa brjod/ de dag gi bar bstod pa bzhin no// glang chen lpags pa bgegs chen te/ drag po'i gzugs ni sdug bsngal ba// sel bar byed pa gtso bo'i gos/ bdud dpung*/ nye ba'i snying po/ sbrul dang thod 'phreng mi 'gyur ba// gtso bo'i rgyan 'phreng sngags dang*/ gsungs chos kyi phyag rgya/ slob dpon 'jigs byed du gsal pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas zhugs/ nyi ma'i steng gi hūm̐ yig mthing nag gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa gyis/ snying po nye snying rtsa sngags 'phreng sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ bcom ldan 'di la dang*/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs brjod/ drag po las kyi dbang*/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes snying rje khros// nas/ bcos ma'i khro byed khyod kyis gzung*// zhes bsgral ba'i chas rnams gtad/ mun sel thugs kyi mngon gyur pa// nas/ gnyug ma'i gnas la 'god par bgyi// zhes tshogs gdab las bya/ la sogs pa sbyor ba'i rdzas kyis/ thun mong khyad par bla na med// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni// dngos dang yid las byung ba dag /nam mkha' mnyam pa snyed kyis mchod// ces pas mchod pa'i dbang*/ dgang gzar blugs gtad/ zhi dang rgyas dang*/ sogs las rab 'byams kyi dbang*/ ral gri sogs gtad/ ral gri mig sman sogs dang*/ de nas/ rdo rje slob dpon du byed pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma'i steng seng ge'i khri'i dbus su slob ma bzhag steng nas gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub cing*/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// zhes pas gsol ba btab/ rnal 'byor gtso bor bskyed/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa til gyi gong bu gtams pa rnams kyis pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bum pas dbang bskur cing*/ oṃ/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// nas/ rdo rje snyems tshul bdag mdzod cig/ zhes pa'i glus dbang bskur/ sgrub thabs bzhin dag pa bstan/ de ni bum dbang ngo*// de nas nam gung la bab pa na tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas/ khyab bdag bdag la sman pa dang*// zhes pa'i sh+lau kas gsol ba btab mig dar bcings/ slob dpon rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag rgya ro langs mar gsal ba rdo rje pad+ma gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pas phung khams skye mched yan lag gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhu ba'i thig le gsang ba gnyis kyi khas lce thog tu/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// zhes pas ster/ a ho mahā su kha zhes pas mid/ gsal stong gi ye shes la cung zad mnyam par zhog mig dar bkrol lo// gsang dbang ngo*// de nas bud med kyi sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du tho rangs maṇ+ḍal phul/ mig dar bcings/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i lag par phyag rgya ma'i lag pa bzung ste/ ji srid rang gi bde 'dod pa// de nyid rol dang sgeg pa yi// de srid phyag rgya lhan cig tu// gnyug ma 'di yis mchod par bya// zhes brjod cing gtad/ slob ma 'jigs byed dang phyag rgya ma yum ro langs mar gsal btab ste snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas gsang ba'i de bzhin nyid du gshegs par gyur ba'i mthar thug pa de'i tshe/ gang yang nyam nga blos thongs tshe// skad cig skad cig dbyer med pa// bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid sad// ma ni mkhan po sgra mkhan dang*// tshad ma rtog ge'i spyod yul min// dgag cing bsgrub las 'das pa na// brjod bral lhan cig skyes dgar gsungs// 'di dag bde bar skyob byed rnams// bslab gzhi 'dul sdom dam tshig kun// nges par bsrung phyir sems bdag nyid// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// dkon mchog gsum gyi dgra bsad cing*// 'dod la nges par chags phyin spyad// gzhan gyi longs spyod bag med blang*// dngos kun rdzun sogs sgyu mar smra// tshogs drug bde chen longs spyod spyad// grub pa lnga dang lcags kyu lnga// longs spyod lnga sogs rgyun tu spyad// rtag tu sems la dngos grub bsgrub// dus gsum rtag pa'i sku ru gnas// zhes ngo sprad pas so so rang rig pa'i rkyen gyis slar gsang gnas nas gtsug tor gyi bar du de bzhin du gshegs pa na/

mig dar bkrol/ slob dpon ston pa'i chas g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas sems can gyi don bsgrub pa'i tshul du langs nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang po thams cad dang mgrin gcig pas// oṃ/ ngas khyod 'di ltar lung bstan te// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// srid pa mchog tu bsgrub pa'i phyir// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ mi bhur bhu waḥswaḥ de nas dbugs dbyung sbyin bya ste// de ring khyod bdag legs par rnyed// mi yi srid pa don dang bcas// sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes// sems nyid rang 'byung ba yi gter// phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas// gsang sngags mnyam med sems las 'grub// zag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor che// mthong ba 'am ni zhugs gyur pas// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// byang chub sems mchog rmad byung rnyed// 'gro ba kun gyi skye gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing duḥkha yi// skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed// srid pa'i ngo bo nyid dag pa'i// phyag na rdo rjer deng gyur to// dbang gsum pa'o// de nas tho rangs sems kyi dkyil 'khor du sems kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya ste/ byang chub chen po'i rgyur gnas pa'i// mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// skye mched khams ni mang po kun// lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ye nas rang byung ye shes che// bdag nyid chen po rtag pa'i lha// ma bsgrubs rdo rje sems dpa' gnas// zhes pas so// bzhi pa tshig dbang ngo*// de nas rnal 'byor pho mo grangs mnyam pa'am phyag rgya gcig dang bcas pa'i dpa' bo'i tshogs gral rim bzhin du byas tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad bsags/ las kyi rdo rje bsang sbyang byas te sbyangs rtogs sbar zhing tshogs byin dbab spyan drangs mchod pa byas/ gzugs kyi gar/ snyan pa'i glu/

dri'i byug pa/ gtor ma phul/ de nas slob dpon la las kyi rdo rjes phyag byas rnal 'byor snod du bdud rtsi gzhan bza' ba la sogs pa sder 'os par bshams nas 'bul/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi nges pas longs spyod/ reg bya'i don du phyag rgya dang rdo rje pad+ma gnyis su med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba bsgom/ de nas bdag bskyed bsdus/ lhag ma btang*/ dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub bsngo'o// rol mo dang mchod pa'i bye brag gis skor ba byas mchod cing bstod nas/ bzod gsol bshags pa byas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rang gi snying gar bsdus rdul tshon a kā ro'i sngags kyis bsdus chu bo chen por dor ro// dug gsum gdug pa nyon mongs byed mkhan rnams// gzhom phyir rgyal ba'i yab cig 'jam pa'i dpal// khros pa'i me phung nyi ma 'bum phrag gis// bsgrubs 'dra dus mtha'i 'jig rten 'di na longs// rang bzos dpyad gsum tshad gdung 'ba' zhig gi /'bab par 'phangs par ngal la snying rje rjes// 'dod ser rtol byas glang chen pad+ma'i mig /thal kar des sbyar cho ga 'dra ba gar// grub pa ston ka'i legs bshad zla ba'i dpyid// ma lus 'phos dgongs rdor 'chang ma dris mtsho// gsum bdun rtog pa'i chu klung cher brdzus nas// myul bar 'ongs pa'ang ro mnyam nyid du song*// rdo rje 'jigs byed mnyes par byed pa'i rim pa 'di yang*/ pad+ma dkar pos la li ta'i sgrub thabs/ de nyid kyi mdzad pa'i dbang chog der kha 'phangs pa a mo gha badz+ras mdzad pa rnams ji lta bar rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sarba mad+ga laṃ// //
